description: A focused AI coding assistant for VS Code.
set.model: The model name to use (empty = the provider default).
set.baseUrl: Endpoint for custom OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM…).
set.showModels: Show the model picker in the chat (the model list is always visible in settings).
set.showThinking: Show the model's reasoning text in the chat.
set.showAiEdits: Highlight lines written by Tulvez Code in the editor.
set.sound: Play a short sound on install and when the panel opens.
set.skillsRegistry: Where skills come from. With a GitHub account address (https://github.com/<account>), that account's public repositories with a SKILL.md at their root install themselves and update every 12 hours; Tulvez Code uses a matching skill on its own. An https address with an index.json at its root also works. Default: Tulvez's GitHub account.
set.gitCoAuthor: Like Copilot: when a file changed by Tulvez Code goes into a commit, a co-author line (Co-authored-by: Tulvez Code) is added at commit time. You stay the author; if Tulvez commits itself, Tulvez Code is the author and you are the co-author. When off, Tulvez appears in no commit; on GitHub, tulvez-code[bot] appears next to you. For this a small prepare-commit-msg hook is installed in the repository's .git/hooks folder (it is not committed); if the repository already has a hook or core.hooksPath, it is left alone and the line is written into the message box. Turning it off removes the hook. Your git identity is not touched.
set.mcpServers: MCP servers (same format as Claude Code / Cursor). Local: `{ "name": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "package"], "env": {} } }` · Remote: `{ "name": { "url": "https://…/mcp", "headers": {} } }`. Tools only run in Build mode, with approval. The project's `.mcp.json` is also read; you are asked for permission before it first runs. `"disabled": true` turns a server off.
set.allowShellCommands: Allow Tulvez Code to run terminal commands.
set.telemetry: Send anonymous usage data (not active yet).
set.sendCodeContext: Add code context to AI requests.
set.language.auto: Follow the VS Code language (Turkish if VS Code is Turkish, otherwise English)
set.language: The language of the Tulvez Code interface and replies. The panel reloads when it changes.
